sources.permitted_use: Occupational crosswalks, task/skill mappings, and derived role requirements with attribution.
sources.retention_scope: Source metadata and derived mappings; raw source files need not be committed.
limitations: United States labor-market context, not Indian hiring outcomes.
Crosswalks to Indian role titles are approximate unless manually reviewed.
sources.verification_note: Database page and license page returned HTTP 200; occupation_data.csv, software_skills.csv, essential_skills.csv, and job_titles.csv were downloaded and inspected. Database version observed as 31.0.

sources.name: ESCO
sources.format: RDF, TTL, ODS, CSV, XML, JSON-LD
sources.acquisition_method: Free download after privacy-statement acceptance and email delivery

license.name: Dataset-specific license requires review
license.attribution: Capture the license and attribution text shipped with the selected ESCO package before ingestion.

sources.permitted_use: Occupation, skill, and qualification crosswalks after legal review of the downloaded package.
sources.retention_scope: Source metadata and approved derived mappings only.
limitations: European occupational context; Indian title mapping is not one-to-one.
License text is not assumed from the download page and must be archived with the package.
sources.verification_note: Download page returned HTTP 200 and exposed dataset v1.2.1 plus supported formats. The page states downloads are free and gated by a privacy statement.

sources.name: National Classification of Occupations 2015
sources.format: Official publication; machine-readable file not verified
sources.acquisition_method: Requires an authorized, versioned NCO file from the National Career Service or Ministry of Labour and Employment

license.name: Government publication reuse terms require confirmation
license.attribution: Record the publisher, publication title, version, and source URL.

sources.permitted_use: Indian occupation classification and role-title crosswalks after the actual publication is archived and reuse is reviewed.
sources.retention_scope: Source metadata and approved derived crosswalks only.
limitations: The NCS portal is client-rendered and direct guessed document URLs returned the app shell.
No NCO file was downloaded or parsed in Phase 1.
sources.verification_note: NCS portal returned HTTP 200. Searches for a direct NCO document were not successful, so no NCO identifiers are claimed in seed rubrics.

sources.name: NSDC Qualification Packs
sources.format: Qualification Pack documents on a dynamic portal
sources.acquisition_method: Portal access; bulk machine-readable API not verified

license.name: NSDC Terms of Use
license.attribution: Link to the official Qualification Pack; do not copy or redistribute without written permission.

sources.permitted_use: Reference and link only until written reuse permission is obtained.
limitations: The published Terms of Use restrict downloading, copying, reproducing, and commercial exploitation without written permission.
No Qualification Pack text is ingested in Phase 1.
sources.verification_note: NSDC home and qualification-packs pages returned HTTP 200. Terms of Use page returned HTTP 200 and contained the restriction language recorded above.

sources.name: Adzuna API
sources.acquisition_method: Register for an app id and API key; use only within an approved plan or license

license.name: Adzuna API Terms of Service
license.attribution: Follow Adzuna display and attribution requirements for any permitted listing use.

sources.permitted_use: Personal job search, personal/academic research, or an appropriately licensed product integration.
sources.retention_scope: Only what the approved plan/license permits; aggregation and raw-data retention require review.
limitations: Commercial analysis and product use require a license.
No API key or posting data is included in Phase 1.
sources.verification_note: Adzuna API site returned HTTP 200. Terms page returned HTTP 200 and restricted commercial analysis, resale, and aggregation without written consent.
